title: Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin Charges) Bill 2024
short_title: Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin Charges) Bill 2024
portfolio: Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would impose charges on participants in a new scheme that tracks and verifies the emissions attributes of low-emissions products and renewable electricity.
The charges would recover the costs of administering the scheme, including monitoring compliance and enforcement, and would be set by regulations.
The scheme would start with hydrogen and later include green metals and low-carbon liquid fuels.
changes: The bill would impose charges on production, delivery and consumption profiles and on registered facilities such as accredited power stations and renewable energy storage facilities.
The bill would allow the Clean Energy Regulator to provide exemptions, waivers, refunds and remissions in circumstances prescribed in rules.
The bill would make the scheme fully cost recovered, with charges set by regulations.
summary.affected: Participants who opt into the Guarantee of Origin scheme, including producers of low-emissions products and renewable electricity.

In other words, they voted in favour of reading the bill for a second time. ### What is the bill's main idea?
